name: THE PATRONS
note:
A drinker above the counter top, as his own sprite with his own beat.
THE BANDS TILE. Cutting each man to his own extent left the columns BETWEEN men owned by nobody, and the strip above the counter is drawn ONLY by these sprites -- so a gap between two of them is a hole straight through the bar. Seams at x216 and x409, both inside ranges identical in every pose. The leaning man lifts his glass and drinks.

sprite.note: A beat, not a loop. Tyler: they are not moving enough. Intervals roughly halved and kept mutually prime so they still drift apart rather than falling into a pattern -- 5, 7, 4 at the table and 6, 4.5, 8 at the bar. With six figures on those intervals somebody moves about every three-quarters of a second.
